description: This file defines a PHP class named 'Coupon' which extends the base Controller class. It provides administrative functions for managing coupon-related features within the Opencart extension system, including methods for displaying the coupon management page ('index') and saving configuration settings ('save'). The file includes logic for loading language strings, setting page titles, managing breadcrumbs, handling permissions, and preparing the view data for rendering the coupon management interface.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: A controller class for managing coupon settings within the Opencart admin extension, providing methods for displaying the coupon configuration page and saving settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the coupon configuration page, loading language strings, setting page titles, generating breadcrumbs, and passing data to the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the coupon configuration settings, including permission validation and JSON response output.
